title_original: What's the difference between volatile and non-volatile memory?
summary_en: The difference comes down to what happens when the power goes off, but that’s only part of how modern memory works.Computer specs often use the word "memory" for several different technologies, which can make volatile and non-volatile memory sound more complicated than they are.The basic distinction is whether stored data survives when power disappears.
